ITEM TRANSCRIPT
Microloans
are
small
loans
provided
to
individuals
,
often
in
developing
countries
,
to
help
them
start
or
expand
a
small
business
.
These
loans
are
usually
given
to
entrepreneurs
who
lack
access
to
traditional
banking
services
.
Unlike
conventional
loans
,
micro
loans
have
lower
interest
rates
and
flexible
repayment
terms
.
Many
micro
loan
programs
are
run
by
non
profitorganizations
or
micro
finance
institutions
.
Studies
show
that
micro
loans
can
empower
individuals
,
especially
women
,
by
providing
them
with
financial
independence
.
However
,
some
critics
argue
that
high
interest
rates
from
certain
lenders
can
create
debt
cycles
.
Overall
,
micro
loans
play
a
crucial
role
in
poverty
reduction
and
economic
growth
.
When
managed
effectively
.
